summary: Configures video texture/format allocation parameters for a texture-format state object. Verifies the stored width (this+0x10) against the expected constant 202, raising an error through the object vtable when it mismatches. Selects a power-of-two scale factor (8/4/2/1) from the raw width/height ratio, derives scaled allocation dimensions via CeilingDivision, then sizes every format entry in the array at *(this+0xC4): assigns each entry its optimal power-of-two scale and its allocation width/height. Finally resolves the output format count from the format-mode field and validates it via ComplexStateValidator, storing either the reference height (this+0x110) or 1.

local_names.v12: format entry pointer for alloc-size writes
local_names.v15: resolved format count written to this+0x68

operations.description: Guard on this+0x10 != 202: when the stored width is not the expected constant, enter the error path.
Error path: set the object behind this+0x0 to error code 18 (obj+0x14) and copy the offending width this+0x10 into obj+0x18.
Error path: invoke the virtual error handler through the object vtable (**(void(__cdecl***)(int))this)(this).
Read raw width (this+0x2C) and raw height (this+0x30) to drive the scale-factor decision.

Select the power-of-two denominator by nested ratio tests (8*width>height, then 4*, then 2*): write this+0x5C = CeilingDivision(this+0x18, denom), compute scaled height via CeilingDivision(this+0x1C, denom), and store the denominator 8/4/2/1 at this+0x114.
Store the scaled allocation height to this+0x60.
Guard on this+0x20 <= 0 (guard:1) and this+0x20 > 0 (guard:2): the two per-entry loops run only when the entry count is positive.

Per-entry optimal-scale loop over the array at *(this+0xC4) (entry pointer +12, stride 0x54): start i at this+0x114 and double up to 8, stopping when 2*i*entryWidth (entry+0x0C) exceeds i*this+0x10C or 2*i*entryHeight exceeds i*this+0x110; write the winning i into entry+0x24.

Per-entry alloc-size loop over the same array (entry pointer +36): write entry+0x28 = CeilingDivision(this+0x18 * entryWidth * entry[-7], 8*this+0x10C) and entry+0x2C = CeilingDivision(entryWidth * this+0x1C * entry[-6], 8*this+0x110).
Resolve the output format count from the format mode this+0x28: mode 1 -> 1, modes 2/3 -> 3, modes 4/5 -> 4, otherwise the entry count this+0x20; write it to this+0x64.
ComplexStateValidator(v14, this) validates the resolved format; on success write this+0x6C = this+0x110, otherwise this+0x6C = 1.
Return the validator result (v16). Called by sub_516C7B.

unresolved: The legacy ABI label Audio_Sample_Rate_Conversion contradicts the video-texture semantics of the body; the packet carries it with LEGACY trust and it is not reflected in the operation model.

The validator argument v14 passed to ComplexStateValidator is the 1/3 candidate (not the entry-count/4 fallback stored at this+0x64); the precise role of v14 versus the stored count is not grounded by the packet.
The object behind this+0x0 (used only on the width-mismatch error path) has no type evidence in this packet.
Field this+0x110 is both a scale-comparison bound and the value stored to this+0x6C on validator success; whether these are two independent meanings is DERIVED.
